items.q:
A: Did you (　) your homework, Kenta?
B: Yes, I finished it before dinner.
items.ex: Did you のあとは動詞の原形。do your homework で「宿題をする」です。

items.q: My grandmother lives in a small town. I often (　) her in summer.
items.ex: visit で「(人を)訪ねる」。夏によくおばあちゃんの家に行く、という意味です。

items.q: It's going to (　) tomorrow, so take your umbrella.
items.ex: be going to のあとは動詞の原形。「明日は雨になりそう」。

items.q: This bag is (　) than that one.
items.ex: than があるので比較級。heavy は y を i にかえて heavier です。

items.q:
A: (　) you help me with these boxes?
B: Sure.
items.ex: Could you ～? は「～していただけますか」とていねいにお願いする言い方です。

items.q: Jane is the (　) runner in her class.
items.ex: the ～ in her class(クラスの中で一番～)なので最上級の fastest。

items.q: We (　) to the zoo last Sunday. It was a lot of fun.
items.ex: last Sunday(この前の日曜日)なので過去形の went です。

items.q: There (　) many people at the station this morning.
items.ex: many people(複数)で this morning(過去)なので were。

items.q: I want (　) a doctor in the future.
items.ex: want to ～ で「～したい」。want to be ～ で「～になりたい」です。

items.q:
A: Where's Dad?
B: He's (　) the car in the garage.
items.ex: He's(He is)のあとに ing 形で「今～している」。

items.q: My brother is good (　) drawing pictures.
items.ex: be good at ～ で「～が得意だ」。

items.q:
A: What are you going to do this weekend?
B: I'm going to (　) a movie with my friends.
items.ex: 映画を見るは see a movie(または watch a movie)。

items.q: You (　) be quiet in the library.
items.ex: must のあとは動詞の原形。must be quiet で「静かにしなければならない」。

items.q:
A: How was the test?
B: It was (　) difficult. I couldn't answer some questions.
items.ex: 形容詞 difficult を強めるのは very(とても)です。

items.q: Mike (　) up late yesterday, so he missed the bus.
items.ex: yesterday なので過去形。get up の過去形は got up です。

items.q:
Boy: Mom, can I go to Tom's house?
Mother: OK, but (　)
Boy: I will.
items.ex: 「6時までに帰ってきてね」→「そうするよ(I will.)」という流れです。

items.q:
Girl: I lost my pencil case.
Boy: (　)
Girl: Thanks. I'll give it back tomorrow.
items.ex: 女の子が「ありがとう、明日返すね」と言っているので、ペンを貸してあげたとわかります。

items.q:
Man: Excuse me. How can I get to the library?
Woman: (　) It's next to the post office.
o: Go straight and turn left at the second corner.
items.ex: How can I get to ～?(～へはどう行けばいいですか)には道順で答えます。

items.q:
Girl 1: Are you free this Saturday?
Girl 2: (　) What's up?
Girl 1: Let's go shopping together.
items.ex: Are you free ～?(ひま?)に Yes, I am. と答え、「どうしたの?」と続けています。

items.q:
Boy: How long did you stay in Kyoto?
Girl: (　)
items.ex: How long(どのくらいの間)には期間 For three days.(3日間)で答えます。

items.jp: あなたはネコとイヌのどちらが好きですか。
items.ex: Which do you like better, A or B? で「AとBのどちらが好きですか」。
items.full: Which do you like better, cats or dogs?

items.jp: 私の夢は世界中を旅行することです。
items.ex: 「～することです」は is to ～。around the world で「世界中を」。My dream is to travel around the world.
items.full: My dream is to travel around the world.

items.jp: 宿題を手伝ってくれてありがとう。
items.ex: Thank you for ～ing.(～してくれてありがとう)。help 人 with ～ で「人の～を手伝う」。
items.full: Thank you for helping me with my homework.

items.jp: 私がこの箱を運ぶのは難しいです。
items.ex: It's difficult for 人 to ～. で「人にとって～するのは難しい」。
items.full: It's difficult for me to carry this box.

items.jp: 図書館には本が何冊ありますか。
items.ex: 数をたずねる How many books のあとに are there(ありますか)が続きます。
items.full: How many books are there in the library?

parts.title: 日本文付き短文の語句整序

blocks.label: [A]
blocks.title: Riverside Library Story Time
blocks.body:
Come and listen to stories in English!
Date: Saturday, July 12
Time: 10:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
Place: Room 2, Riverside Library
Children from 5 to 9 years old can join. Parents can come, too.
After the stories, we will make paper animals together.
If you want to join, please call the library by July 10.
Phone: 555-0134

qs.ex: 10:30 a.m. から 11:30 a.m. までなので1時間です。
After the stories, we will make paper animals together. とあります。

blocks.label: [B]
blocks.body:
From: Emily Clark
To: Haruka Sato
Date: May 20
Subject: Your visit

Hi Haruka,
Thank you for your email. I'm happy that you're coming to Canada this summer! You'll stay with my family for two weeks, right? My mother says you can use my sister's room. My sister is studying in Toronto now, so her room is free.
In August, my town has a big music festival. Many people come to listen to music in the park. Do you want to go with me? Also, what food do you like? My father loves cooking, and he wants to make dinner for you.
Your friend,
Emily

From: Haruka Sato
To: Emily Clark
Date: May 21
Subject: Thank you!

Hi Emily,
Thanks for your email. Yes, I'll stay with your family for two weeks, from August 3 to August 17. I'd love to go to the music festival with you! I play the trumpet in the brass band at my school, so I love music.
I can eat almost everything, but I don't like spicy food very much. I'm going to bring some Japanese snacks for your family. I'm really excited!
See you soon,
Haruka

qs.q: Where will Haruka sleep in Canada?
qs.ex: Emily のお母さんが「妹の部屋を使っていい」と言っています。

qs.q: What does Emily's father want to do?
qs.ex: he wants to make dinner for you とあります。

qs.q: What is Haruka going to bring?
qs.ex: I'm going to bring some Japanese snacks for your family. とあります。

blocks.label: [C]
blocks.title: Daniel's Vegetable Garden
blocks.body:
Daniel is thirteen years old and lives in a small town in Australia. Last spring, his grandfather gave him some seeds. "Let's grow vegetables together," he said. Daniel didn't know much about plants, but he wanted to try.
First, they made a small garden behind Daniel's house. They planted tomatoes, carrots, and beans. Every morning before school, Daniel gave water to the plants. Sometimes he forgot, and his grandfather called him and said, "Your tomatoes are thirsty!"
In summer, the weather was very hot, and some of the beans died. Daniel was sad, but his grandfather told him, "Don't worry. Farmers have problems every year. Let's put some straw on the ground. It will keep the soil wet." Daniel did that, and the other plants grew well.
In February, Daniel picked his first tomatoes. They were small, but they were sweet. He took them to school and shared them with his friends. His teacher, Ms. White, liked them very much. She asked Daniel to talk about his garden in class.
Now Daniel wants to grow strawberries next year. He also wants to start a garden club at his school.

qs.ex: his grandfather gave him some seeds とあります。

qs.q: What did Daniel do every morning?
o: He gave water to the plants.
qs.ex: Every morning before school, Daniel gave water to the plants. とあります。

qs.q: Why did some of the beans die?
qs.ex: the weather was very hot, and some of the beans died とあります。

qs.q: What did Ms. White ask Daniel to do?
o: Talk about his garden in class.
qs.ex: She asked Daniel to talk about his garden in class. とあります。

o: A boy who goes to a farm in Japan.
A boy who grows vegetables with his grandfather.
qs.ex: おじいさんと一緒に野菜を育てた男の子の話です。

items.ex: 「ピザ食べる?」→「うん、お願い。」

o: I bought it at the station.
items.ex: Is it interesting?(おもしろい?)に「うん、すごくワクワクする」と答えます。
How about ～?(～はどう?)とすすめられて「ええ、いただきます」。
Can I use yours?(あなたのを使っていい?)→「いいよ、はいどうぞ」。

lines: Yes. I'm looking for a T-shirt.
items.ex: What color(何色)と聞かれているので色で答えます。

lines: Hello. This is Ken. Is Mike there?
items.ex: When(いつ)なので時間で答えます。

lines: Mom, this is a present for you.
Oh, thank you! What is it?
items.ex: プレゼントを開けたお母さんの反応です。

lines: Excuse me. Does this train go to Midori Station?
items.ex: How long does it take?(どのくらいかかる?)には時間で答えます。

lines: Your dog is so cute. What's his name?
items.ex: How old(何歳)なので年齢で答えます。

lines: I went to bed late last night.
o: I was watching a soccer game.
items.ex: Why(なぜ)と聞かれているので理由を答えます。

lines: Mom, have you seen my soccer shoes?
Then check the car. You used them yesterday.
items.q: Where will the boy look for his shoes next?
items.ex: お母さんが Then check the car.(じゃあ車を見て)と言っています。

lines: What are you going to do during summer vacation, Mr. Lee?
I'm going to visit my parents in Korea.
Sounds nice. How long will you stay?
items.q: What is Mr. Lee going to do?
items.ex: I'm going to visit my parents in Korea. と言っています。

lines: Excuse me. How much is this cake?
items.q: How many cakes will the woman buy?
items.ex: I'll take two(2つください)と言っています。six dollars は値段です。

lines: Did you go to the movie with Kate yesterday?
No. She was sick, so I went with my sister.
items.q: Who did the girl go to the movie with?
items.ex: Kate は病気だったので、妹(姉)と行きました。

lines: Just a minute, Dad. I'm finishing my homework.
OK. Come down in five minutes.
items.q: What is Lucy doing now?
items.ex: I'm finishing my homework.(宿題を終わらせているところ)と言っています。

lines: I'm going to the library after school. Do you want to come?
I can't. I have tennis practice.
items.q: When will they go to the library?
items.ex: 今日はテニスの練習があるので、明日行くことにしました。

lines: How do you go to school, Jack?
I usually walk, but today I took the bus.
items.q: How did Jack go to school today?
items.ex: いつもは歩きですが、今日は雨だったのでバスで行きました。

lines: This is a nice picture. Did you draw it?
No, my brother did. He wants to be an artist.
items.q: Who drew the picture?
items.ex: my brother did(兄[弟]が描いた)と女の子が言っています。

lines: Excuse me. Is there a post office near here?
Yes. Go down this street. It's next to the bank.
items.q: Where is the post office?
items.ex: It's next to the bank.(銀行のとなり)と言っています。

lines: I'm going to make cookies for Mom's birthday.
That's a good idea. When is her birthday?
items.q: What will the girl make?
items.ex: I'm going to make cookies と言っています。

lines: I usually go to bed at ten. But last night, I watched a soccer game on TV, so I went to bed at twelve. This morning, I was very sleepy.
items.q: Why was the boy sleepy this morning?
items.ex: サッカーの試合を見て12時に寝たからです。

lines: My family has a cat and two dogs. The cat is old, but the dogs are young. I walk the dogs every morning.
items.q: How many dogs does the girl's family have?
items.ex: a cat and two dogs(ねこ1匹と犬2匹)です。

lines: Attention, please. Today's tennis practice is canceled because of the rain. Students in the tennis club should go to the gym. We'll have a meeting there.
items.q: Where should the tennis club students go?
items.ex: should go to the gym(体育館に行くこと)とあります。

lines: Yesterday was my mother's birthday. My sister and I made a cake for her. My father bought flowers. My mother was very happy.
items.q: What did the girl's father do?
items.ex: My father bought flowers. とあります。ケーキを作ったのは姉妹です。

lines: Mike likes sports. He plays baseball on weekends and swims on Wednesdays. Next year, he wants to try basketball.
items.q: What does Mike do on Wednesdays?
items.ex: swims on Wednesdays(水曜日に泳ぐ)とあります。

lines: Last summer, I went to Hokkaido with my family. We stayed there for five days. The weather was cool, and the food was delicious. I want to go there again in winter.
items.q: When does the boy want to go to Hokkaido again?
items.ex: I want to go there again in winter. とあります。

lines: I'm Sara. I'm a high school student. I work at a bakery on Saturdays. I'm saving money because I want to buy a new computer.
items.q: Why is Sara saving money?
items.ex: I want to buy a new computer が理由です。

lines: Welcome to Green Zoo. The zoo closes at five p.m. today. The lion show starts at two p.m. near the main gate. Please enjoy your day.
items.q: What time does the lion show start?
items.ex: The lion show starts at two p.m. とあります。5時は閉園時間です。

lines: My brother is a cook. He works at a restaurant near the station. On his days off, he often cooks for our family. His curry is the best.
items.q: Where does the girl's brother work?
items.ex: He works at a restaurant near the station. とあります。

lines: Yesterday, I lost my key on the way home. I looked everywhere. Then my friend Ben called me. He found it at the park.
items.q: Who found the key?
items.ex: 友達の Ben が公園で見つけてくれました。
